  mode: blocks
  title: acme/rubric-shapes
  instruction: 5 words; starts 'Fix the bug in `app.py`.'
  blocks: toml task
  config: block (name, version)
  rubric: 10 criteria, 3 gates, 8 points; judges agent, human, llm, panel, robot, rule, test, vlm
  grading needs a model: yes: agent judges 3 criteria; llm judges 1 criterion; panel judges 1 criterion; vlm judges 1 criterion; 1 criterion wait for human raters
  judge agent: model from the run, harness judge-loop@1*, samples 1*, per rubric*, timeout 20m*, no token budget (the timeout bounds it); * marks a default
  judge llm: model from the run, samples 1*, per criterion*, timeout 2m*; * marks a default
  judge panel: model from the run, samples 1*, per criterion*, timeout 2m*; * marks a default
  judge vlm: model from the run, samples 1*, per criterion*, timeout 2m*; * marks a default
  worst-case grading time: 26m (agent 1 x 20m + llm 1 x 2m + panel 1 x 2m + vlm 1 x 2m; in sequence, before retries), plus the scripts of the task, which no [verifier] timeout bounds
